layer_1.description: Each node attends to its direct neighbors
layer_1.example_block_2: b'₂ now aware of b'₁ (predecessor) and b'₃ (successor)

layer_2.description: 2-hop context — each node now has information from 2 edges away
layer_2.example_block_2: b'₂ now aware of b'₀, b'₁, b'₃, b'₄ (full chain)

attention_pooling.description: Learned MLP scores each block, softmax gives weights, weighted sum → f
attention_pooling.interpretation: Blocks with external calls (socket, bind, listen) get ~90% of total attention. Prologue/epilogue blocks are near-zero — they're generic stack setup/teardown.

output.description: Single vector summarizing the entire function's code structure

kept_for_option_c.individual_block_embeddings: b'₀ through b'₄ also kept (not discarded after pooling)
kept_for_option_c.usage: Option C decoder cross-attends to these individually
